home.whatIsP1: 《怪诞马戏团》是一款由独立开发者 Garula（又名 Neko Bueno）创作的心理恐怖视觉小说，发布于 itch.io。该游戏凭借其令人难忘的哥特式艺术风格、道德复杂的角色以及深度分支叙事，赢得了国际粉丝的热情追捧 The Freak Circus 是一款由独立开发者 Garula（又名 Neko Bueno）创作的心理恐怖视觉小说，在 itch.io 上发布。该游戏凭借其令人难忘的哥特艺术风格、道德复杂的角色和深度分支叙事，赢得了国际粉丝的热情追捧。
home.whatIsP2: 你作为一个陌生人来到一个偏远的马戏团。起初只是好奇，很快就变成了纠缠。每一个选择都将塑造你的命运，以及五位非凡表演者的命运——他们一直在等待像你这样的人。
features: 五位可攻略角色的多条故事路线
分支叙事，包含明确的好结局和坏结局
哥特式心理恐怖氛围与原创艺术
免费游玩，支持浏览器和下载
home.charactersP: 五位表演者塑造了每一次游戏体验：Pierrot、Harlequin、Jester、售票员和医生。每一位都有独特的故事线、结局集以及与主角的关系弧线。
tipsList: Take your time reading each scene. The Freak Circus rewards attention to small details in dialogue and environment.
Do not reload saves to undo choices on your first playthrough. Your natural decisions lead to the most meaningful experience.
Play through at least twice. A second playthrough of The Freak Circus reveals dialogue and scenes you missed the first time.
Pay close attention to the Ticket Taker. He says more than he appears to say.
Each character route has a Good Ending and at least one Bad Ending. Refer to the walkthrough after your first play.

faqItems.q: Is The Freak Circus free to play?
faqItems.a: Yes. The Freak Circus is completely free to play in your browser on this site. You can also download it from the official itch.io page.

faqItems.q: Do I need to download anything?
faqItems.a: No. The Freak Circus runs directly in your browser. Just click the play button on this page and it loads instantly.

faqItems.q: How long does The Freak Circus take to finish?
faqItems.a: A single playthrough takes about 2 to 3 hours. To experience all five routes and endings, expect 10 to 15 hours total.
Yes. The game includes a built-in save system. You can save at any decision point and return later. Progress is stored in your browser.

faqItems.q: What makes The Freak Circus unique?
faqItems.a: It stands out for its gothic psychological horror atmosphere, morally complex characters, and deeply branching narrative where every choice carries real weight.

faqItems.q: Will progress carry over between devices?
faqItems.a: Saves are stored locally in your browser. If you want to continue on another device, you can download the game from itch.io and transfer your save files.

faqItems.q: Is The Freak Circus suitable for all ages?
faqItems.a: No. The Freak Circus is rated 18+ and contains mature themes including psychological horror, possessive relationships, and dark romance.

faqItems.q: What is the difference between routes?
faqItems.a: Each character route offers a completely different perspective. Pierrot focuses on psychological dependence. Harlequin explores chaos and performance. Jester examines entertainment ethics. The Ticket Taker reveals the deepest lore. The Doctor contains the most intimate and unsettling content.
It runs in most modern mobile browsers, though the experience is optimized for desktop and tablet. For the best experience, use a desktop or laptop computer.

home.howToPlayP1: Playing The Freak Circus is simple. The game runs entirely in your browser — no download or installation needed. Click the play button above to launch it directly on this page. This visual novel uses a classic interface: read the story, make choices at key moments, and watch how your decisions shape the narrative.
home.howToPlayP2: Each playthrough of The Freak Circus takes roughly 2 to 3 hours depending on how carefully you read and explore. There are five main story routes, each tied to a different performer: Pierrot, Harlequin, Jester, the Ticket Taker, and the Doctor. Your first playthrough will naturally lead toward one or two of these characters based on the choices you make early in the story.
home.howToPlayP3: New players of The Freak Circus should focus on enjoying the atmosphere and characters rather than optimizing for a specific ending on their first run. Multiple playthroughs are rewarded — each route reveals new scenes, dialogue, and backstory you cannot see in a single run.
home.storyP1: The Freak Circus begins when you stumble upon a traveling circus that has arrived in town unannounced. Drawn by an inexplicable pull, you step past the entrance and into a world where reality bends. Each of the five performers offers a different perspective on the circus hidden history.
home.storyP2: As night falls on the second day, the masks begin to slip. You are forced to confront uncomfortable truths about desire, control, and the stories we tell ourselves. The endings range from tender to terrifying, and the game does not judge whichever path you choose — it simply shows you where it leads.
home.tipsTitle: Tips for Playing The Freak Circus
home.whyPlayText: The Freak Circus has earned a dedicated following because it offers something rare in the genre: genuinely difficult choices that carry real emotional weight. It does not hold your hand or tell you which choice is right. The art style — all hand-drawn gothic illustrations — sets this visual novel apart from typical anime-style titles. Combined with a branching narrative system that tracks over a dozen variables per playthrough, it delivers a different experience every time you play.
home.storyP3: The circus itself is a character in its own right. The tents shift positions between visits, the carnival games seem to know your thoughts, and the performers remember conversations you never had. By the time you realize the circus is alive, it may already be too late to leave.
home.gameplayP: Gameplay centers on dialogue choices that appear throughout each day. Some choices are timed, adding tension to conversations. Others are deceptively simple — a single word can redirect an entire character route. The game tracks affinity levels with each character, hidden flags for story branches, and cumulative choices that affect the final ending. Even seemingly minor interactions can cascade into major consequences later. The save system lets you revisit key decision points, making it easy to explore alternative paths without restarting from scratch. Each choice matters, and no two playthroughs ever feel quite the same.

trivia.q: How tall is Pierrot from The Freak Circus?
trivia.a: Pierrot official height has not been disclosed by the developer. Fan estimates based on in-game sprite comparisons suggest he is of average to tall build. Check the Pierrot character page for more details.

Pierrot is frequently categorized by fans as a 'silent yandere' — his possessiveness develops gradually rather than manifesting immediately. His route explores themes of obsession and emotional control. Visit the Pierrot route guide for more insight.

trivia.q: What is Harlequin relationship with Pierrot?
trivia.a: Harlequin and Pierrot share one of the most complex dynamics in The Freak Circus. Their relationship is part rivalry, part codependence, with their shared history involving Columbina. This backstory is revealed differently depending on which route you play.

trivia.q: What happened to Columbina in The Freak Circus?
trivia.a: Columbina backstory is deliberately kept ambiguous and is revealed in fragments through Pierrot and Harlequin routes. She appears only in flashback sequences and is central to understanding the circus hidden history. Read the Columbina lore page for what is known.

trivia.q: Can you romance the Ticket Taker?
trivia.a: Yes. The Ticket Taker has a romanceable route in The Freak Circus. His route requires persistence and careful attention to dialogue. He reveals the deepest lore about the circus origins. See the Ticket Taker route guide for tips.

trivia.q: Does The Doctor have a good ending?
trivia.a: Yes, the Doctor route has at least one Good Ending. The Doctor route has been expanded with additional content. Accept his examination scenes and make specific dialogue choices to unlock the Clean Hands ending. See the Doctor character page for details.

characters.title: 《怪诞马戏团》角色介绍
characters.subtitle: 五位非凡的表演者。五条故事线。一个命运。

list.name: Pierrot
list.description: 克制、忧郁且洞察力极强。Pierrot 是马戏团的情感支柱，为嘲笑他眼泪的观众表演悲伤。他的路线对心理要求最高，揭示了马戏团真实本质的更多传说。
list.routeTip: 在第一天选择内省和共情的对话。在第二天避免反抗以解锁好结局。

list.name: Harlequin
list.description: 难以预测且富有戏剧性，Harlequin 用不断变化的表演掩盖了动荡的过去。他与 Pierrot 的关系是游戏的核心动态之一。
list.routeTip: 在第一天选择红色气球。在帐篷遭遇中使用大胆、俏皮的回应。

list.name: Jester
list.description: Jester 存在于其他表演者之间，既不完全忠诚也不完全敌对。他的路线探索了娱乐的伦理以及让别人发笑意味着什么。
list.routeTip: Jester 的路线在第二天解锁。用幽默回应但避免直接对抗。

list.name: 售票员
list.description: 你遇到的第一个角色。售票员控制着谁进谁出，他对这个马戏团的观察时间远比其他人意识到的要长。
list.routeTip: 直接回答售票员的每个问题。他的路线需要坚持不懈。

list.name: 医生
list.description: 医生的路线是最近扩展的，包含了一些游戏中最黑暗的内容。他有条不紊、亲密且令人深感不安。
list.routeTip: 医生的内容主要集中在第二天。接受他的检查场景以推进他的路线。

meta.title: Pierrot - The Freak Circus Character Guide
meta.desc: Meet Pierrot the Weeping Clown from The Freak Circus. Learn about his yandere-type personality, route guide, fanart, and role in the story.

pierrot.appearance: Pierrot has a lean, androgynous build with pale skin and dark hollowed eyes. He wears a classic white clown costume with black diamond accents and a single tear painted beneath his left eye. His official height has not been disclosed. He is often depicted holding a wilted flower or a broken mirror.
pierrot.personality: Pierrot is controlled, melancholic, and intensely perceptive. He performs sorrow for crowds who laugh at his tears, but behind the performance lies a deeply possessive and dangerous personality. Fans often categorize him as a 'silent yandere' type — his affection turns obsessive gradually, making his route one of the most psychologically intense in the game.
pierrot.routeDesc: Pierrot's route is the most psychologically demanding in the game. To pursue his route, choose introspective and empathetic dialogue options during Day 1 carnival encounters. Follow the white cloak during the tent scene. During Day 2, prioritize understanding over resistance to unlock the Good Ending. Pierrot's route reveals the deepest lore about the circus history and his relationship with Columbina.
reviews: Pierrot's route stayed with me for days. The writing makes you feel genuinely torn between wanting to save him and needing to escape him.
The psychological tension in Pierrot's route is unmatched. The voice acting for his breakdown scene is incredible.
I went into this game expecting a simple romance and came out emotionally devastated by Pierrot's storyline.

meta.title: Harlequin - The Freak Circus Character Guide
meta.desc: Meet Harlequin the Chaotic Performer from The Freak Circus. Learn about his volatile personality, route tips, and role in the story.

harlequin.appearance: Harlequin has a tall, athletic build with sharp facial features and wild, two-toned hair. His costume is a traditional diamond-patterned harlequin suit in red and gold, complete with a half-mask that he wears at an angle. His official height has not been disclosed by the developer.
harlequin.personality: Unpredictable and theatrical, Harlequin masks a turbulent past behind an ever-shifting performance. One moment he is playful and flirtatious, the next he is dangerous and unreadable. His relationship with Pierrot is one of the most complex dynamics in The Freak Circus — part rivalry, part codependence.
harlequin.routeDesc: Harlequin's route rewards bold choices. Select the red balloon during the Day 1 carnival opening. Use playful, daring responses during main tent encounters. His route escalates quickly during Day 2 — embrace the chaos rather than resist it. Harlequin's route explores themes of performance, identity, and the cost of wearing a mask.
reviews: Harlequin is the kind of character you hate to love. His route made me genuinely uncomfortable in the best way.
The chaos energy of Harlequin is off the charts. Every scene with him keeps you guessing.
His backstory reveal in Day 2 completely changed how I saw his character. The writing is superb.

meta.title: Jester - The Freak Circus Character Guide
meta.desc: Meet Jester the Trickster from The Freak Circus. Learn about his ambiguous personality, route guide, and role in the story.

jester.appearance: Jester has a smaller, agile build with wide, expressive eyes and a permanent smirk. His costume is a multi-colored jester outfit with bells on the pointed collar and curled shoes. His official height and age have not been disclosed.
jester.personality: Jester exists between the other performers, neither fully loyal nor fully antagonistic. He plays tricks on everyone but never reveals his own hand. His ambiguous alignment makes him one of the most unpredictable characters in The Freak Circus — you never know if he is helping you or setting you up.
jester.routeDesc: Jester's route is unlocked during Day 2. Respond with humor and wit, but avoid direct confrontation. Jester respects cleverness over brute honesty. His route explores the ethics of entertainment and what it means to make others laugh while hiding your own pain.
reviews: Jester quickly became my favorite. His humor hides so much pain and the route reveals it beautifully.
The Jester route has the best writing for comedic timing. Some lines genuinely made me laugh out loud.
His route twist in the second act caught me completely off guard. Do not underestimate him.

meta.title: The Doctor - The Freak Circus Character Guide
meta.desc: Meet the Doctor, the Surgeon of Secrets from The Freak Circus. Learn about his clinical personality, route guide, and role in the story.

doctor.appearance: The Doctor is tall and composed, with sharp features and cold, analytical eyes. He wears a vintage medical coat stained with what appears to be old blood, layered over a formal waistcoat. His official height has not been disclosed. He carries a leather doctor bag that never leaves his side.
doctor.personality: The Doctor is methodical, intimate, and deeply unsettling. He approaches every interaction as if conducting an examination — clinical in speech, unnerving in touch. His route contains some of the darkest content in The Freak Circus, exploring themes of control, vulnerability, and the ethics of care.
doctor.routeDesc: The Doctor's content is largely concentrated in Day 2. Accept his examination scenes to progress his route. His route requires a willingness to engage with uncomfortable dynamics. The Doctor route has been recently expanded with new content by the developer, adding additional scenes and an extended ending sequence.
reviews: The Doctor's route is not for everyone, but if you enjoy dark romance with psychological depth, it is incredibly well-written.
I was genuinely unsettled during his examination scenes. The game does not hold back.
The expanded content for his route adds so much depth. The new ending made me rethink his entire character.

meta.title: Columbina - The Freak Circus Character Guide
meta.desc: Meet Columbina from The Freak Circus. Learn about her mysterious past with Pierrot, her role in the circus lore, and what fans speculate about her.

columbina.appearance: Columbina is described through in-game text and flashback sequences as having a delicate frame, porcelain features, and a soft, melancholic expression. She wears a traditional Columbina costume — a flowing white and gold dress with a small half-mask. Her official height has not been disclosed. Her appearance is only shown in fragmented CG sequences and character memories.
columbina.personality: Columbina is a figure of tragedy and mystery in The Freak Circus. She is central to the backstory of both Pierrot and Harlequin, though she never appears as a living character in the main timeline. Her past actions and relationship with the circus performers shape much of the present-day narrative. Fan theories about Columbina vary widely, as the game deliberately keeps her story ambiguous.
columbina.routeDesc: Columbina does not have a romanceable route in The Freak Circus. She is a lore-only character whose story is revealed through Pierrot and Harlequin routes. Piecing together her history is one of the main motivations for multiple playthroughs.
reviews: The Columbina reveal completely reframes Pierrot entire route. I had to replay immediately.
Every mention of Columbina in the game is heartbreaking. The writing team did an amazing job with her tragic story.
I spent hours on forums discussing Columbina theories after finishing the game. That is how compelling her character is.

meta.title: Ticket Taker TFC - The Freak Circus Character Guide
meta.desc: Meet the Ticket Taker from The Freak Circus. Learn about his cryptic personality, gatekeeper role, route guide, and lore significance.

ticket-taker.appearance: The Ticket Taker is an older, stoic figure with silver-streaked hair and piercing eyes that seem to look through you. He wears a vintage railway conductor uniform with brass buttons and always carries a leather-bound ticket book. His official height has not been disclosed. He is the first character you meet when entering the circus.
ticket-taker.personality: The first character you encounter. The Ticket Taker controls who enters and who leaves, and has watched everything at this circus for far longer than the others realize. His cryptic comments often carry double meanings that only become clear on replay. He speaks in riddles and seems to know more about the protagonist than he lets on.
ticket-taker.routeDesc: The Ticket Taker route requires persistence. Engage directly with every question he asks — deflect his tests at your own risk. His route rewards players who pay attention to the smallest details in dialogue. The Ticket Taker reveals the deepest lore about the circus origins and the nature of the performers contract.
reviews: The Ticket Taker quickly went from creepy gatekeeper to fascinating character. His route has the best lore payoff in the game.
Every line the Ticket Taker speaks is important. I started taking notes on my second playthrough.
His route answers questions you did not even know you had. The lore reveal is worth the effort of unlocking his path.

Explore the booths. Each interaction subtly shifts character affinities. The red balloon leads toward Harlequin. The white cloak reveals Pierrot path.
Your seat choice and reactions during the main performance influence which performer notices you. Front row signals boldness. Balcony suggests introspection.
The dinner scene is a major branching point. Your dialogue choices here can lock or unlock specific routes for Day 2.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your data on thefreakcircus.help.
privacy.s1body: thefreakcircus.help does not collect, store, or process any personal data from visitors. We do not use cookies for tracking purposes beyond the language preference cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) which stores your selected language and nothing else. The embedded game is served directly from the official CDN and we do not have access to any data transmitted during gameplay.
privacy.s2body: The Freak Circus game itself is embedded via an iframe from the official CDN. That service may collect its own data according to its own privacy policy, which we do not control. We recommend reviewing the official itch.io page for the game's data practices. We also use Google Analytics for basic anonymous traffic analysis; this can be blocked via browser extensions.
privacy.s3body: As a visitor to this fan site, you have the right to browse anonymously, block cookies via your browser settings, and use ad-blocking or tracking protection extensions. If you have concerns about data handling, please contact us through the official itch.io page.

wiki.title: The Freak Circus Wiki & Lore Guide
wiki.subtitle: Complete encyclopedia of The Freak Circus lore, characters, and setting.

meta.title: The Freak Circus Wiki - Complete Lore & Setting Guide
meta.desc: Explore the complete The Freak Circus wiki including character lore, circus setting, glossary of terms, development timeline, and developer credits.

wiki.overviewP1: This page provides complete The Freak Circus encyclopedia资料 including character profiles, story setting, and update history. Whether you are a new player looking to understand the story or a veteran seeking deeper lore, this wiki covers everything known about the game.
wiki.overviewP2: Information here is based on officially confirmed game content. Community speculation is clearly marked where included.
wiki.loreP1: The Freak Circus is set in a mysterious circus that appears only at night at the edge of a fog-shrouded town. The circus exists in a liminal space — it arrives without warning and leaves the same way. The five performers are bound to the circus by an agreement that predates the events of the game, though the exact nature of this agreement is deliberately left ambiguous.
wiki.loreP2: The circus grounds include the main performance tent, the carnival midway, individual performer spaces, and hidden areas that only become accessible on specific routes. The layout shifts between visits, suggesting the circus itself is alive and responsive to the protagonist choices.

glossary.def: The nightly show each performer gives. The Performance is both literal entertainment and a metaphor for each character hidden nature.
An agreement binding each performer to the circus. The terms are never fully explained but hinted at through character dialogue.
The two active days of gameplay. The story unfolds across this timeframe, with choices determining which routes open.
Each character route has at least two endings. Good Endings require specific choice combinations. Bad Endings trigger through defiance or passive acceptance.

glossary.term: The Tear Painted on Pierrot Face
glossary.def: A permanent makeup mark that symbolizes his perpetual performance of sorrow. It never washes off.

wiki.creditsP1: The Freak Circus was developed by Garula (also known as Neko Bueno). The game is published on itch.io and is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, as well as directly in browser via official CDN embedding.
wiki.creditsP2: Full voice cast and additional credits have not been publicly disclosed by the developer. This section will be updated as more information becomes available.

timeline.desc: The Freak Circus first released on itch.io with Pierrot, Harlequin, Jester, Ticket Taker, and Doctor routes available.
Additional scenes and an extended ending added to the Doctor route based on player feedback.
Official Simplified Chinese language support added alongside continuing English content updates.
The developer has indicated ongoing work on additional content. Day 3 and new character content are anticipated.
